scope.parity_rule: Every required surface-state cell must pass. A failed, partial, blocked, or unknown child prevents parent and project acceptance.
scope.extensions_rule: Approved extensions are excluded from the parity denominator and must not replace, overlap, obscure, or alter an original path.

authority_tiers.description: Lossless original-executable capture with version, locale, fixture, and input trace
Original executable or decompiled constructor, paint routine, command mapping, and geometry
Extracted resource identity plus two corroborating original-game visual sources
Authenticated original-game screenshot or video without executable mapping
Memory, inference, recreation, modded media, or unverified derivative

findings.title: Campaign cockpit contains stretched and replacement composition
Galaxy, stars, sector hulls, systems, and facilities use synthetic primitives
System selection opens an invented right sidebar
Original advisor idle runs render in WASM; unobscured shell integration and authored behavior remain open
Browser pack includes ALSPRITE and EMSPRITE bitmap/type-302 resources; briefing, dialog, encyclopedia, advisor-control, and voice families remain omitted
WASM encyclopedia image loading always returns no texture
Original object, finder, production, mission, message, and option layouts are replaced or absent
Original battle alert and report flow is absent or bypassed
Tactical HUD uses partial original art inside a replacement composition
Live ground-combat screen is an invented surface
Original modeless window and reference-rail behavior is absent
Rare and transient original screenshot states remain uncaptured

tranches.name: Strategic Cockpit Truth
tranches.exit: Both factions pass exact shell, galaxy/GID, controls, modeless system navigation, embedded advisors, and markers on native and WASM with zero invented or blank required elements.

tranches.name: System Management and Cockpit Destinations
tranches.exit: Original sector/system windows, finders, messages, options, encyclopedia, reference rail, and return paths pass.

tranches.name: Objects, Fleets, Production, Missions, and Research
tranches.exit: Every original object, status, action, and result family passes all required state cells.

tranches.name: Briefings, Events, Reports, Encyclopedia, and End States
tranches.exit: Original media, event, battle-entry, report, victory, and defeat presentation passes on native and WASM.

tranches.name: Space-Battle Tactical Interface
tranches.exit: The complete original space-battle composition, both faction HUDs, ships, fighters, controls, state art, audio, reports, strategic return, and Death Star paths pass. Ground assault uses only its original summary and report flow.

tranches.name: Multiplayer and Release Matrix
tranches.exit: The shuttle interaction-state matrix, two-peer multiplayer, cross-browser viewports, resource sweep, accessibility overlays, performance, and every required surface-state cell pass.

next_action: Execute RE-ADV-02 for authored advisor actions, cadence, and voice; then implement RE-STR-01 through RE-GID-01 for the exact strategic shell, unobscured droid apertures, controls, system navigation, and GID.
